subject.title: [Bug]: Sandbox prune does not clean up workspace directory

question: Should idle/max-age prune workspace cleanup be folded into the managed sandbox lifecycle work, or should maintainers land a separate narrow prune fix first?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the fix deletes sandbox workspace state and overlaps a broader lifecycle design plus an open same-symptom fork PR.

options.title: Fold Into Lifecycle PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98766 as the owner-reviewed path if it explicitly covers idle/max-age prune workspace cleanup and refreshes exact-head proof.

options.title: Land Narrow Prune Fix
options.body: Adopt a focused fix that removes only eligible non-shared local sandbox workspaces after successful runtime cleanup and proves shared, agent, rw, browser, Docker, SSH, and OpenShell safety.

options.title: Pause Until Fork Is Superseded
options.body: Resolve or supersede the open same-symptom fork PR so there is one canonical implementation route before more repair work starts.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Lifecycle PR
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98766 as the owner-reviewed path if it explicitly covers idle/max-age prune workspace cleanup and refreshes exact-head proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest sandbox cleanup history and owns the broader managed lifecycle work that may absorb this fix.
